shell_commands: /usr/bin/zsh -lc "pwd && sed -n '1,240p' ../ticket.md && if test -f ../round-brief.md; then sed -n '1,260p' ../round-brief.md; fi && sed -n '1,260p' .lore/dod.md"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git branch --show-current && git status --short && sed -n '1,210p' src/transport/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts && sed -n '1,220p' specs/hal-engine-conversation-list/spec.md && sed -n '1,220p' specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md && cat package.json | sed -n '1,180p'"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "rg -n \"conversationList\\.acceptance\\.test\\.ts#L|accepts a bare list_sessions|answers list_sessions|answers an empty session_list\" specs && nl -ba src/transport/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts | sed -n '30,155p' && rg --files scripts/spec-links scripts 2>/dev/null | rg 'reanchor|anchor-names'"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'timeout 300 npm run spec:names:fix && npx prettier --write src/transport/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts specs/hal-engine-conversation-list/spec.md specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md .lore/dod.md && git diff -- src/transport/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts specs/hal-engine-conversation-list/spec.md specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md .lore/dod.md'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'npx prettier --write .lore/dod.md && git diff --check && git status --short && git diff --stat && git diff -- .lore/dod.md src/transport/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts specs/hal-engine-conversation-list/spec.md specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git add .lore/dod.md src/transport/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts specs/hal-engine-conversation-list/spec.md specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md && git commit -m "Fix conversation list CI findings" && git push origin HEAD'
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git fetch origin main && git merge --no-edit origin/main && git push origin HEAD && git status --short --branch'
